To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Gail Turner <gail.turner@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Q4: Director, Model Serving — comp-band exception & hire authorization

Team — quick summary and ask: we’ve converged on Alicia Johnson (ref: CV attached) for the Director, Model Serving role supporting real-time inference and Dedicated launch work. Hiring manager (Gail) has indicated a firm start window the week of Oct 11; candidate is evaluating two offers and needs a written offer by Oct 4 to lock.

Why I’m flagging this as an exception: the candidate’s market ask pushes her above our published Director band by roughly $20k base and slightly higher RSU requirement to offset market comp in SF. Proposal (attached proposed-offer-AJ-20270930.pdf):
- Base: $235,000 (band midpoint is $215,000)
- Target bonus: 20%
- RSU grant: 0.9% 4-year vest (front-loaded year 1)

Ask: 1) Exec sign-off to exceed the band by $20k base + the equity uplift; 2) formal headcount authorization for Q4 (we will reallocate one open IC slot from infra hiring to cover the HC; see cost-model-q4-hc.xlsx).

Notes: this hire is time-sensitive given candidate timeline and the operational risk to Dedicated launch if we miss this hire. I’ve attached the CV and a short cost model showing net ARR impact and blended cost per token improvement assumptions.

Attachments: cand_AJohnson_CV.pdf, proposed-offer-AJ-20270930.pdf, cost-model-q4-hc.xlsx

Next steps I propose:
- Aditya: quick OK on compensation exception?
- Marcus: budget alignment OK if we reallocate IC slot?
- Laura: any objections from people ops or comp governance?

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Head of Talent Acceleration (acting)
Redwood Inference

- Approve the $20k over-band base and the 0.9% RSU (as a one-off exception)
- Final sign-off contingent on Finance confirming the HC reallocation (Priyom: please confirm the IC slot you’re moving and that it’s not required elsewhere)

Priyom — please cc Finance/Ted once you’ve reallocated and we’ll rubber stamp. Marcus, Laura — flag me if you see any governance issues.

Thanks — a few practical questions before I record final approval on my side:
1) Long-term cash impact: can we push some of the RSU into performance-based vesting (year 2–4) to reduce immediate dilution?
2) HC trade: which IC slot exactly is being reallocated? If we’re pulling from infra SRE hiring, that has downstream SLA risk. If from Sales Ops we can probably move it. Priyom — please call out the slot in the cost model.
3) Signal to market: if we make exceptions frequently it shifts expectations. I’m ok with this one as a single exception for Q4, but please document as exception request in HR-117.

If we can tweak the RSU cadence (front-loaded like 0.6% YE1 + performance tranche) I’ll approve the base + equity uplift. Aditya — happy to push this through quickly once Priyom confirms the slot and the adjusted grant schedule.

Thanks — quick note from the hiring manager side: Alicia is enthusiastic about Redwood and is holding for our timeline. She’s indicated she needs a written offer by Oct 4 to decide in our favor. If you can get a signed offer out by end of day Oct 4 (EOD), she’s prepared to accept and start Oct 11–18 (two weeks notice) which matches our launch needs.

From the hiring manager POV I’m comfortable with the adjusted grant cadence Marcus suggested (front-load smaller cash/equity in year 1 and tie the remainder to performance milestones). She has strong domain experience in low-latency serving and will materially de-risk Dedicated’s Q1 roadmap.

Happy to jump on a quick 15-min call if you want to align wording in the offer letter.

Best,

Head of ML Platforms, Aurora Health
